title: Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc Anime Reveals More Cast, October 2 Debut
content:
REMOW revealed on Saturday more cast and the October 2 debut for the Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc television anime based on Yura Urushibara 's Tougen Anki: Dark Demon of Paradise manga. REMOW also revealed a new visual and a new promotional video.

Region-free version

REMOW also revealed the anime's theme songs. Hiromitsu Kitayama performs the opening theme song "Backlash," and TRACK15 performs the ending theme song "Hand in Hand."

New cast members announced on Saturday include:

Kenichi Suzumura as Kusabi Momoura, the chief of the Momotaro Agency Kegon Falls Branch

Yūki Kaji as Hizumi Momotsugi, the 10th Unit Captain of the Momotaro Agency Kegon Falls Branch Laboratory

Kishō Taniyama as Senritsu Momoo, the 3rd Unit Vice-Captain of the Momotaro Agency Kegon Falls Branch Laboratory

Two special recap episodes will air on September 30 for the Kyoto arc and on October 1 for the Nerima arc before the new anime's October 2 debut. The anime will debut on streaming services outside Japan on October 2 at 25:00 JST (effectively October 3 at 1:00 a.m.). The series will stream outside Japan on the following platforms: NETFLIX , Crunchyroll , Amazon Prime Video , Rakuten Viki , It's Anime ( YouTube ), Anime Generation , Aniverse , ADN , AMEDIATEKA , It's Anime (FAST) ( Samsung TV Plus , VIZIO WatchFree+, Live TV on PS5, Pluto TV , Prime Video), KT genieTV, SK BTV , LG U+TV, KT Skylife TV, Cable VOD , TVING, WAVVE, Laftel, WATCHA PLAY, JBOX , DAEWON (ANIWON, ANIBOX ), bilibili , Bahamut, My-Video , 中華電信/HamiVideo, LINE TV, and friDay.

REMOW describes the new arc:

Having survived the fierce battles in Kyoto and Nerima, Shiki and his fellow students at Rasetsu Academy are steadily growing stronger. But Yaoroshi rejects Mudano's lessons on the importance of friendship. Drawn to Oni Brigade General Hayate Todoroki's call for “the total eradication of the Momotaro,” he leaves the academy. When Shiki realizes that the Oni Brigade's creed makes even noncombatants targets for slaughter, he sets out after Yaoroshi with Mudano and the other students. Their destination is Nikko, where Kegon Falls stopped flowing some time ago, and a massive research facility has since been built. Within its walls, horrific experiments are underway...

Previously announced new cast members for the season include:

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Hagure Nekosaki

• Kent Itō as Yu Innami

• Gakuto Kajiwara as Hayate Todoroki

• Kentarō Kumagai as Uri Torikai

• Ryūho Nagaoka as Shinichi Fuwa

• Tomohiro Ōno as Misaki Kako

• Shintarō Ōhata as Gou Todomeki

• Yuki Sakakihara as Kyoutarou Otohara

• Wataru Hatano as Akari Hirunuma

• Hitomi Ueda as Miyo Umitsuki

The Tougen Anki anime debuted in July 2025. The "Nerima Arc" began in October 2025.

The anime streams outside Japan on the following platforms: Crunchyroll , Netflix , Prime Video, Samsung TV Plus , Anime Onegai , Bandplay , ADN , ANIME GENERATION , Anime Key, iQIYI international, bilibili (Bstation), Laftel, Bahamut, My-Video , 中華電信MOD, HamiVideo, KKTV, friDay, LINE TV, ANIWON, ANIBOX , TVING, WAVVE, LAFTEL, WATCHA PLAY, KT genieTV, SK BTV , and LG U+TV.

On Prime Video, the series is available worldwide except in Japan and Mainland China, and on Netflix the series is available worldwide outside of Japan. Crunchyroll is also releasing an English dub for the series.

The anime also has a mini companion anime titled Onimomomomo . The staff released the episodes weekly alongside the main episodes.

Ato Nonaka is directing the anime at Studio Hibari . Hiroyuki Hashimoto is the assistant director. Yukie Sugawara ( The Idolm@ster SideM , No Guns Life , The Unwanted Undead Adventurer ) is writing and supervising the anime's scripts. Ryoko Amisaki ( Kino's Journey - The Beautiful World ) is designing the characters. Hiroyuki Becchaku is the art designer, while Scott MacDonald is directing the art. Saki Tada is the color key artist. Naoki Serizawa is the compositing director of photography. Ryota Fukushima is directing the CG. Yumika Okazaki is editing. Satoki Iida is directing the sound, and Kohta Yamamoto is composing the music. Pony Canyon is credited for the music production.

Urushibara launched the manga in Akita Publishing 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in June 2020. The 30th compiled book volume shipped on July 8. Yen Press began publishing the manga in English in September 2024. It shipped the fifth volume on May 26.

The manga previously inspired a stage play that ran Tokyo and Osaka in February 2024, and a sequel stage play ran in January 2025.

title: TOUGEN ANKI Season 2 Reveals New Key Visual, English Trailer, Additional Cast, October 2 Premiere
content:
TOUGEN ANKI Season 2, titled the Nikko Kegon Falls Arc , revealed a new key visual, trailer, cast, and October 2, 2026 premiere. The sequel was officially announced after Season 1’s final Episode 24, while the anime previously introduced members of the Oni Brigade . Ato Nonaka directs the anime at Studio HIBARI, with Yukie Sugawara handling series composition and the screenplay.

The newly announced cast members are:

• Kenichi Suzumura as Kusabi Momoura, chief of the Momotaro Agency’s Kegon Falls Branch Laboratory

• Yuki Kaji as Hizumi Momotsugi, the laboratory’s 10th Unit Captain

• Kisho Taniyama as Senritsu Momoo, the laboratory’s 3rd Unit Vice-Captain

The new arc will follow Shiki and his fellow Rasetsu Academy students as they travel to Nikko after Yaoroshi leaves the academy to join the Oni Brigade. Their destination is a research facility built near Kegon Falls, where experiments involving Oni are taking place.

Hiromitsu Kitayama performs the opening theme “BACKLASH,” while TRACK15 performs the ending theme “Hand in Hand.” You can watch the new trailer below.

Two special recap episodes will air ahead of the premiere, covering the Kyoto Arc on September 30 and the Nerima Arc on October 1. Also check out the new key visual.

Yura Urushibara writes and draws the TOUGEN ANKI manga series, which has been serialized in AKITASHOTEN’s Weekly Shonen Champion magazine since 2020. The manga has sold over 4 million copies in Japan so far.

The anime is directed by Ato Nonaka, with Hiroyuki Hashimoto serving as assistant director. The series composition and script are handled by Yukie Sugawara, while Ryoko Amisaki is in charge of character design. The music for the anime is composed by KOHTA YAMAMOTO and produced by PONY CANYON.

We previously spoke with the main voice cast of TOUGEN ANKI ahead of its premiere, which includes Kazuki Ura (Shiki Ichinose), Hiroshi Kamiya (Naito Mudano), and Koutaro Nishiyama (Jin Kogasaki). Since then, the cast has grown to also feature Aimi as Kuina Sazanami, Kaito Miura as Rokuro Kiriyama, Natsuki Hanae as Jyuji Yusurube, Shogo Sakata as Ikari Yaoroshi, and Manaka Iwami as Homare Byoubugaura.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess' Season 2 Light Anime Reveals Theme Song in 3rd Teaser Video
content:
The official website for the second light anime season based on SORAJIMA and Aminohada 's With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess ( Kizu Darake Seijo Yori Hōfuku wo Komete ) vertical-scrolling webtoon started streaming the anime's third teaser promotional video on Saturday. The video reveals and previews Juice=Juice's theme song "Kareinaru Revenger" (The Great Revenger).

The anime will premiere on October 1 on the TV Kanagawa (tvk) channel at 24:00 JST (effectively October 2 at 12 midnight), and will then run on CBC TV from October 2 at 26:59 JST (effectively October 3 at 2:59 a.m.).

Returning cast members from the first season include:

• Asami Seto as Rua

• Sōma Saitō as Sven

• Momo Asakura as Arianne

• Kazuki Ura as Garrett

• Kazuyuki Okitsu as Cezee

• Tomoaki Maeno as Prince Sarid

• Minami Tsuda as Diana Peridot

• Reiō Tsuchida as Luis Riston

Saya Fukase ( Hyakki Yakou Shou , I Want You To Show Me Your Panties With a Disgusted Face Returns ) is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos / Imageworks Studio , replacing first season's director Chisaki . Returning staff members include sound director Yūichi Imaizumi , Hiroki Nozaki and Airi Kobayashi for sound effects, music composer onoken , and Kazuya Takahashi overseeing the production.

The anime's first season debuted in July 2025 on tvk and CBC TV , and also streamed on various streaming services in Japan.

Tappytoon releases the series. Pocket Comics had been releasing the series in English before the service shut down , and it described the story:

Rua is a saintess candidate who possesses the power of healing. But her ability had one flaw: she could only heal others by transferring their wounds onto herself. Because of this, others bullied her, calling her the "Fallen Saintess." But it didn't bother Rua because her best friend Arianne always stood up for her. One day, Rua's crush, Commander Garrett, was on the brink of death from a beast attack. Rua healed him, which left her on the verge of death. When she woke up, she learned that all the credit was given to Arianne, and she finally saw her best friend's true color. Devastated, Rua is lost and helpless when the second prince appears in front of her with a tempting offer. What would happen to Rua as she begins her new life as a villainess?

In Japan, the webtoon runs on comico. The series launched in August 2022 and in English in October 2022. The series' main story ended in June 2025. The series has been releasing side story chapters since it ended, but announced in October 2025 that it will go on hiatus indefinitely.

DNP spearheaded the concept of "light anime" to create animation at a lower cost on a more "timely" schedule compared to the traditional animation production workflow.
author: ANN

title: 'Shin Oishinbo' New TV Anime Announced
content:
A new television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya 's Oshinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo was announced at the Shin-Ei Animation 50th Anniversary special stage at ABEMA Anime Festival 2026 on Saturday, revealing the announcement promotional video.

Kariya began writing Oishinbo in Shogakukan's Big Comic Spirits magazine in 1983, featuring art by Akira Hanazaki . Shogakukan published the 111th and latest volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since May 2014.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and published seven themed compilation volumes under its VIZ Signature imprint from January 2009 to January 2010.

Shin-Ei Animation produced a television anime based on the manga that ran for 136 episodes from October 1988 to March 1992.

title: Oishinbo Gourmet Manga Gets New TV Anime
content:
The ABEMA Anime Matsuri 2026 event on Saturday revealed that storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga is getting a new television anime series titled Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo). Shinei Animation announced the anime at its 50th anniversary celebration stage presentation at the event.

The duo originally launched the manga in 1983. Shogakukan published the 111th volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since 2014.

The manga depicts the "fierce food showdown" between the newspaper Tōzai Shimbun's "Ultimate Menu" and gourmand Yuzan Kaibara's "Supreme Menu."

A previous television anime adaptation from Shinei Animation aired for 136 episodes from 1988 to 1992. The anime also includes two additional specials.

Viz Media has published five volumes of Oishinbo on its VizManga.com digital manga service and Viz Manga App, and has also published the volumes in print.

The manga has also inspired several live-action series and a live-action film.

title: Inherit the Winds Anime Reveals Theatrical Screening Trailer, Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content:
The staff for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) began streaming on Saturday a trailer for the anime's advanced two-week screening. The staff also unveiled the theme songs and an additional cast member.

Quruli and hitsujibungaku are performing the television anime's opening theme song "Kaze wo Tsugumono" (Inherit the Winds) and ending theme song "Namida no Kawa" (River of Tears). The latter is also the theatical screening's theme song.

Takaya Kamikawa joins the cast as Umeda Shinbei:

The anime will then debut in January 2027 on the "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated networks.

The anime takes place in the Bakumatsu era in Kyoto. A solider who has lost his memories is aided by the famous Shinsengumi member Okita Sōji. Okita Sōji names this man "Tachikawa Jinsuke." Jinsuke's life begins anew amidst the Mibu soldiers.

The anime will star ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ):

• Daisuke Sakuma (Snow Man member) as Tachikawa Jinsuke

• Yūki Kaji as Okita Sōji

• Aoi Yūki as Koganei Hyōgo

• Kōki Uchiyama as Hijikata Toshizō

• Yūichi Nakamura as Kondō Isami

• Nichika Ōmori as Kurosuke

• Ryōhei Kimura as Nagakura Shinpachi

• Ayumu Murase as Tōdō Heisuke

• Simba Tsuchiya as Harada Sanosuke

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Yamanaka Keisuke

• Yasuyuki Kase as Serizawa Kamo

Yutaka Narui and Aniplex are in charge of the original story with cooperation by Azuki Mashiba . Tomohiro Kawamura is directing the anime at Live2D Creative Studio and Drive Inc. Narui is also writing the scripts. Fumi Ebina is the character designer, and Shigeru Kishida is composing the music.

The anime's four-panel manga adaptation launches on Star Seas Company 's Twi4 (read as Tsuiyon) X (formerly Twitter ) account in 2026. Matsuri Muramatsu draws the manga.

Narui is a playwright and founder of the theatrical troupe Caramel Box who has previously worked on many stage plays themed on the Shinsengumi. While one of the plays was also titled Kaze wo Tsugumono , the way the title is written is different (with "mono" being written in kanji for the play and in hiragana for the anime), and the anime is still listed as being an "original" TV anime.

title: 'Dengeki Daisy' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo, 2 Consecutive Cours for Winter 2027
content:
The stage event for the television anime adaptation of Kyousuke Motomi 's Dengeki Daisy manga at the Kyoto International Manga Anime Fair 2026 revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Saturday. The anime series will air in two consecutive cours beginning January 2027.

title: Yaiba: Samurai Legend Anime's 2nd Season Debuts on January 9
content:
The official website for Yaiba: Samurai Legend ( Shin Samurai-den YAIBA ), the new television anime of Detective Conan creator Gōshō Aoyama 's Yaiba manga, revealed a new visual and January 2027 debut on Saturday for the anime's second season .

The new season will debut on January 9, 2027 and will again air on YTV , NTV , and their affiliates on Saturdays at 5:30 p.m. JST.

Takahiro Hasui (episode director for Aikatsu Friends! , Mob Psycho 100 II ) is returning to direct the anime at Wit Studio , with animation cooperation by Studio Kurm .

Tōko Machida ( 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life , The IDOLM@STER ) is again in charge or series scripts, and Yoshimichi Kameda (chief animation director for INU-OH film) is again the character designer and chief animation director. Takeshi Maenami (key animator for Ni no Kuni , Uma Musume Pretty Derby: Beginning of a New Era films) is again the sub-character designer and main animator. Yutaka Yamada ( Tokyo Ghoul ) and Yoshiaki Dewa ( IRODUKU: The World in Colors ) are returning to compose the music. Haru Yamada ( IRODUKU: The World in Colors , Made in Abyss ) is the sound director, and Maiko Okada ( Great Pretender razbliuto , After the Rain ) is returning as the animation producer.

Other new and returning staff members include:

• Art Director: Yūsuke Takeda (Bamboo)

• Background Art: Kazushi Fujii

• Color Design: Satoshi Hashimoto

• Director of Photography: Yūdai Oda (Follum) (new)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Effects: Eiko Morikawa

The first season debuted in April 2025 on YTV , NTV , and their affiliates throughout Japan and aired on Saturdays at 5:30 p.m., right before Detective Conan 's 6:00 p.m. timeslot to start the " Gōshō Aoyama Hour" block. The second cours (quarter of a year) debuted in June 2025.

The anime streams on Netflix in North America, Latin America, Australia, and New Zealand. The show also streams on Hulu in the United States.

Viz Media has licensed the anime, and the company describes the story:

Yaiba Kurogane has spent his days training in the jungle in order to attain his goal of becoming a real samurai. By a twist of fate, he returns to Japan and starts living with the Mine family, who are connected to his father, Kenjuro. Yaiba constantly baffles the Mines' daughter Sayaka as she witnesses his wild and reckless ways. One day, Yaiba tags along with Sayaka to school and has a fateful encounter with Takeshi Onimaru, a kendo expert. Yaiba and Onimaru repeatedly clash, and as if in response to their search for strength, two ancient powers are unleashed: the Fujinken, the Wind God's Sword, and the Raijinken, the Thunder God's Sword. Both supernatural blades that have jolted the world since ancient days have reawakened...and the truth behind them is revealed!

Aoyama launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday in September 1988. The series concluded in December 1993 with a total of 24 compiled book volumes.

The series inspired a 52-episode anime adaptation that ran from April 1993-April 1994.

Viz Media is also releasing the manga in English.

title: Dengeki Daisy TV Anime Reveals January 2027 Debut, Half-Year Run in Main Promo Video
content:
A stage presentation at the KyoMAF event on Saturday revealed the main promotional video for the television anime of Kyousuke Motomi 's Dengeki Daisy shōjo manga. The video reveals the anime will debut in January 2027 and will air for two consecutive cours (quarter of a year).

The video also revealed four new cast members:

• Tomokazu Sugita as Sōichirō Kurebayashi

• Yuka Terasaki as Riko Onizuka

• Setsuji Satō as Masuda

• Kōhei Amasaki as Akira

Additionally, the event also revealed a new key visual.

The event also revealed more staff for the anime:

• Art Design: Kenichi Tajiri (Mukuo Studio), Goichi Katanosaka (GNK30)

• Prop Design: Shūhei Nishitani

• Color Design: Mizuki Nakagawa

• Art Directors: Rieko Itai, Chun Ri Rong (Inspired)

• Director of Photography: Woorapon Jalacorn

• 3D Director: Shinsuke Ōshima

• Editing: Akane Shiraishi

• Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa

• Sound Production: Magic Capsule

Crunchyroll will stream the anime.

Sōta Ueno ( Days With My Stepsister , SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table ) is directing the anime at Studio DEEN . Sawako Hirabayashi ( Wolf Girl & Black Prince , Delicious Party♡Precure , I’ll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History ) is in charge of the series scripts. Ayaka Murakami ( Days With My Stepsister ) is designing the characters, and Masaru Yokoyama composing the music.

Viz Media 's Shojo Beat imprint published the manga in English and describes the story:

After orphan Teru Kurebayashi loses her beloved older brother, she finds solace in the messages she exchanges with DAISY, an enigmatic figure who can only be reached through the cell phone her brother left her. Meanwhile, mysterious Tasuku Kurosaki always seems to be around whenever Teru needs help… Could DAISY be a lot closer than Teru thinks?

Motomi ( Queen's Quality , QQ Sweeper , Beast Master ) launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Monthly Betsucomi magazine in 2007, and ended it in 2013. Shogakukan published the manga's 16th and final compiled book volume in February 2014.

title: Asteroid Daianji Makes the First Three Volumes of Asteroid in Love Free To Read
content:
Manga Time Kirara Carat has announced that Asteroid in Love ‘s first three volumes will be free to read from September 18th to the 23rd to celebrate the discovery of asteroid Daianji.

Come On! Impacting Asteroids (COIAS) discovered asteroid Daianji (2015 FX 488 , #865364) using archival data from the Subaru Telescope at the Mauna Kea Observatory.

Naming regulations give the team at the Subaru Telescope the right to name asteroid #865364. But the Mauna Observatory allowed COIAS to name the minor planet. The COIAS team honored one of the discoverers, a fifth-year student at Okayama Daianji Junior High School, by naming the asteroid “Daianji.” On September 7, 2026, the International Astronomical Union’s Working Group on the Naming of Small Objects (WGSBN) published the name in its bulletin .

Asteroid Daianji has a 0.046 elliptical orbit and an orbital length radius of 2.75 au. Its orbit allows it to pass as close as 1.1617 au to Earth. Other scientific details include:

• Average Perihelion of 268.844°

• Perihelion distance of 2.600 au and a perihelion arguments of 250682°

• Orbital cycle of 1,643,134 days and an orbital angle of inclination of 1.877°

• Tislan Parameter of 3354

COIAS has previously named an asteroid after Quro . Asteroid in Love ’s Ao Manaka and Hoshizaki High School also boast an asteroid named after them.

Quro debuted Asteroid in Love ( Koisuru Asteroid )in January 2017. Houbunsha’s Manga Time Kirara Carat serialized the manga until its June 2024 conclusion. The publisher compiled the manga into six tankobon volumes.

*AU = astronomical unit; the average distance between the Earth and the Sun ( about 149.6 million kilometers or 92.96 million miles).
